Empirical Tests of the Pollution Haven Hypothesis When Environmental Regulation is Endogenous
abstract: The pollution haven hypothesis (PHH) posits that production within polluting industries will shift to locations with lax environmental regulation. While straightforward, the existing empirical literature is inconclusive owing to two shortcomings. First, unobserved heterogeneity and measurement error are typically ignored due to the lack of a credible, traditional instrumental variable for regulation. Second, geographic spillovers have not been adequately incorporated into tests of the PHH. We overcome these issues utilizing two novel identification strategies within a model incorporating spillovers. Using US state-level data, own environmental regulation negatively impacts inbound foreign direct investment. Moreover, endogeneity is both statistically and economically relevant. Copyright © 2015 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.
abstract_zh: 污染避难所假说（PHH）认为，污染行业的生产将转移到环境监管宽松的地区。尽管该假说表述简单，但现有的实证文献尚无定论，原因有两点。第一，由于缺乏可信的传统工具变量来处理监管问题，不可观测的异质性和测量误差通常被忽略。第二，地理溢出效应在PHH检验中未得到充分纳入。我们利用两种新颖的识别策略，在纳入溢出效应的模型中解决了这些问题。利用美国州级数据，本国的环境监管对外国直接投资的流入产生负向影响。此外，内生性在统计上和经济上都是相关的。版权所有 © 2015 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.

Environmental Federalism: A Survey of the Empirical Literature
abstract: Environmental federalism refers to the debate over the 'optimal' level of government at which to delegate environmental policymaking. Although this issue receives widespread attention across the globe, opinions run the gamut. The diversity of views plays out in practice as well as different federations have 'resolved' the issue differently. With the United States alone, environmental authority has oscillated between periods of relatively greater centralized and decentralized control. This article seeks to accomplish two objectives in order to advance the literature. The first objective is to provide a brief overview of the two primary theoretical frameworks  Tiebout (1956) and models of interjurisdictional competition  used to explore the effects of the decentralization of policy decisions such as taxes, expenditures, environmental standards, etc. The reason for doing so is to illuminate the issues that play a fundamental role in conclusions regarding the 'optimal' allocation of environmental authority. The second objective is to then provide a comprehensive survey of the relevant empirical literatures. By doing so, the goal is to limit the scope of the debate over environmental federalism moving forward, as well as make clear where the gaps in empirical knowledge exist.
abstract_zh: 环境联邦主义指的是关于环境政策制定应由哪一级政府负责“最优”的辩论。尽管这一问题在全球范围内受到广泛关注，但各方观点千差万别。不同的联邦制国家以不同方式“解决”了这一问题，观点的多样性也在实践中得到了体现。仅在美国，环境管辖权就在相对集中与相对分散的控制之间反复摇摆。本文旨在通过两个目标推进相关文献。第一个目标是简要概述两种主要的理论框架：蒂布特模型（Tiebout，1956）以及辖区间竞争模型，它们被用来探讨税收、支出、环境标准等政策决策分散化的影响。这样做的目的在于阐明那些对环境管辖权“最优”配置结论起根本性作用的问题。第二个目标是对相关实证文献进行全面综述。通过这一综述，我们力求限定未来环境联邦主义辩论的范围，并明确指出实证知识的空白所在。

Pollution Abatement Costs and Foreign Direct Investment Inflows to U.S. States: A Nonparametric Reassessment
abstract: Keller and Levinson (2002) utilize state-level panel data on inflows of foreign direct investment along with an innovative measure of relative pollution abatement costs to assess the impact of environmental stringency on capital flows. Using standard parametric panel data models, the authors find moderate evidence that capital flows are sensitive to abatement costs. Using recently developed nonparametric methods, we assess the robustness of this conclusion. The nonparametric approach reveals that (a) some of the parametric results are not robust, and (b) the impact of relative abatement costs is heterogeneous across states and generally of smaller magnitude than previously suggested.
abstract_zh: Keller和Levinson（2002）利用州级面板数据，结合一项关于相对污染治理成本的创新性度量，考察了外国直接投资流入量，以评估环境严格程度对资本流动的影响。使用标准的参数化面板数据模型，两位作者发现资本流动对治理成本具有中等程度的敏感性。我们采用近期发展起来的非参数方法，检验了这一结论的稳健性。非参数方法表明：(a) 部分参数化结果并不稳健；(b) 相对治理成本的影响在各州之间存在异质性，且总体上小于先前所暗示的幅度。

Robust Inference Concerning Recent Trends in U.S. Environmental Quality
abstract: Understanding trends in environmental quality is important for individuals and policymakers. Typically, trends in environmental quality are determined solely through comparisons of unconditional or conditional mean pollution levels. However, reaching unambiguous conclusions on the basis of only the first moment of the (unconditional or conditional) distribution is problematic since it ignores what is occurring in different regions of the distribution. Even relying on indices that incorporate both mean and variance is suspect to the extent that relative rankings are not typically robust to index choice. Addressing these concerns, we adapt recent developments in the stochastic dominance literature to test for unambiguous relations between current and past distributions of toxic releases. Using EPA data from 1988–1999, we find statistically significant evidence that the unconditional 1999 distributions of air, land, underground and total toxic releases dominate in a first‐degree sense their respective 1988 distributions. While some of this improvement is explained by economic growth, pollution net‐of‐income improved over the sample period as well. Finally, we document robust differences in the distribution of pollution across regions in the US. Copyright © 2004 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.
abstract_zh: 理解环境质量的变化趋势，对个人和政策制定者都很重要。通常，环境质量的变化趋势仅通过比较无条件或条件平均污染水平来判定。然而，仅依据（无条件或条件）分布的一阶矩得出明确结论是有问题的，因为这忽略了分布不同区域内正在发生的变化。即便依赖同时纳入均值与方差的指数，也值得怀疑，因为相对排序通常会因指数选择的不同而不稳健。针对这些问题，我们改编了随机占优文献中的最新进展，以检验有毒物质释放在当前与过去分布之间是否存在明确的关系。利用1988至1999年的EPA数据，我们发现统计上显著的证据表明：1999年空气、土地、地下及有毒物质释放总量的无条件分布，在一阶意义上优于其各自1988年的分布。尽管部分改善可由经济增长解释，但在扣除收入影响后，污染水平在样本期内也有所改善。最后，我们记录了美国各地区污染分布的稳健差异。

title: Chasing the Smokestack: Strategic Policymaking With Multiple Instruments
Comparative Politics and Environmental Taxation
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: In this paper, we take a step towards understanding the role of democratic institutions on the level of pollution taxation. Persson et al. (J. Polit. Economy 108 (2000) 1121) argue that presidential-congressional regimes set lower taxes than parliamentary regimes. This conclusion results from the checks and balances built into the former, and the higher degree of legislative cohesion in the latter. We test this prediction on gasoline and diesel prices using the method of propensity score matching along with data from 86 democratic countries. The empirical evidence is consonant with the theory: we find that ceteris paribus the average price of super gasoline is $0.14–$0.20 less per liter in presidential-congressional systems; the average price of diesel gasoline is $0.11–$0.14 less per liter.
abstract_zh: 本文试图理解民主制度对污染税水平的作用。Persson等人（J. Polit. Economy 108 (2000) 1121）认为，总统—国会制国家的税收低于议会制国家。这一结论源于前者内置的制衡机制，以及后者更高程度的立法凝聚力。我们采用倾向得分匹配方法，利用来自86个民主国家的数据，检验了这一关于汽油和柴油价格的预测。实证证据与理论相一致：我们发现，在其他条件不变的情况下，总统—国会制国家的超级汽油平均价格每升低0.14至0.20美元；柴油平均价格每升低0.11至0.14美元。

A Natural Experiment on the 'Race to the Bottom' Hypothesis: Testing for Stochastic Dominance in Temporal Pollution Trends
abstract: Devolution of tasks to local levels of government has recently become a popular agenda item within certain political factions in the US. While one expects the local policymaker to tailor policies to match the preferences of his constituents, critics of local policymaking claim that externalities are ignored and inefficiencies thus arise under local control of certain policies. A primary example concerns the control of pollution, which is known to have adverse effects on neighbouring jurisdictions. Whether localities actually ‘race to the bottom’ and enact lax environmental policies when given the chance remains an open issue. In this study, we make use of stochastic dominance tests to examine if President Reagan's policy of ‘New Federalism’ in the early 1980s induced states to lower environmental standards. Among the several environmental measures analysed, we do not find any evidence that the ‘race to the bottom’ materialized. Indeed, the evidence shows that even during these lean years of federal intervention several indicators of environmental quality at the state level continued to improve.
abstract_zh: 近年来，将事务下放至地方政府层级，已成为美国某些政治派别中流行的议程之一。虽然人们预期地方政策制定者会调整政策，以符合其选民的偏好，但地方政策的批评者认为，在某些政策由地方控制的情况下，外部性会被忽视，从而产生效率损失。一个典型例子涉及污染控制，已知污染会对邻近辖区产生不利影响。地方政府在获得机会时是否真的会“竞相降低标准”（race to the bottom），并制定宽松的环境政策，目前仍是一个未决问题。在本研究中，我们利用随机占优检验，考察里根总统在20世纪80年代初推行的“新联邦主义”政策是否促使各州降低环境标准。在所分析的多项环境指标中，我们没有发现“竞相降低标准”现象出现的任何证据。事实上，证据显示，即使在联邦干预较少的这段时期，州一级的若干环境质量指标仍在持续改善。

title: An Environmental Paglin-Gini
abstract: The concept of an environmental Gini coefficient has been used recently by several researchers. In line with Paglin's historical critique of the income Gini coefficient, an environmental Paglin-Gini is proposed and estimated, more carefully considering the notion of ‘perfect environmental inequality.’
abstract_zh: 环境基尼系数这一概念近来已被多位研究者使用。本文沿袭Paglin对收入基尼系数的历史性批评，提出并估算了环境Paglin-Gini指数，并更为审慎地考虑了“完全环境不平等”的概念。

title: Assessing the Empirical Impact of Environmental Federalism
abstract: Many theoretical models analyze the effects of decentralized environmental policymaking. The predictions range from a race to the top, a race to the bottom, or no effect. However, little empirical evidence exists to resolve this ambiguity. This paper fills the void by examining the impact of decentralized environmental policymaking in the U.S. under Presidents Ronald Reagan and George H.W. Bush. For abatement expenditures, Reagan's decentralization had no discernible impact before the mid‐1980s, but by the mid‐1980s the data are consistent with decentralization leading to a race to the top. No statistically significant effect is found on nitrogen oxide or sulfur dioxide emissions.
abstract_zh: 许多理论模型分析了分散化环境决策的效应。其预测从“向上竞争”、“向下竞争”到无影响不等。然而，几乎没有实证证据能够解决这一模糊性。本文通过考察罗纳德·里根和乔治·H.W.布什两任总统任期内美国环境决策分散化的影响，填补了这一空白。就治理支出而言，里根时期的分散化在20世纪80年代中期之前并无可察觉的影响，但到80年代中期，数据与分散化导致“向上竞争”的情形相一致。对氮氧化物或二氧化硫排放，则未发现统计上显著的影响。

title: Effects of Air Quality Regulation on the Destination Choice of Relocating Firms
Effects of Environmental Regulations on Manufacturing Plant Births: Evidence from a Propensity Score Matching Estimator
abstract: This study examines the effects of air quality regulation on economic activity. Anecdotal evidence and some recent empirical studies suggest that an inverse relationship exists between the stringency of environmental regulations and new plant formations. Using a unique county-level data set for New York State from 1980 to 1990, we revisit this conjecture using a seminonparametric method based on propensity score matching. Our empirical estimates suggest that pollution-intensive plants are responding to environmental regulations; more importantly, we find that traditional parametric methods used in previous studies may dramatically understate the impact of more stringent regulations.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了空气质量监管对经济活动的影响。轶事证据以及一些近期的实证研究表明，环境监管的严格程度与新工厂的设立之间存在反向关系。利用纽约州1980至1990年独特的县级数据集，我们采用基于倾向得分匹配的半非参数方法，重新检验了这一推测。我们的实证估计表明，高污染工厂确实会对环境监管作出反应；更重要的是，我们发现以往研究中使用的传统参数方法，可能会严重低估更严格监管的影响。

title: Environmental Abatement Costs and Establishment Size
abstract: The impact of environmental abatement costs on the size distribution of manufacturing establishments in pollution‐intensive industries is analyzed. Utilizing both state‐ and industry‐specific measures of environmental regulation, a new and important interaction is discovered: Establishment size increases with state environmental abatement costs, but only in industries during periods of relatively high (national) pollution abatement intensity. Increased state environmental stringency during times when similar industries located in other states are not undertaking sufficient abatement expenditures leads to a decrease in establishment size. (JEL L11, L51, R38)
abstract_zh: 本文分析了环境治理成本对污染密集型行业制造企业规模分布的影响。利用州层面和行业层面的环境监管度量，我们发现了一种新的重要交互作用：只有在全国污染治理强度相对较高的时期，行业中的企业规模才会随州环境治理成本的上升而增大。当其他州的类似行业未进行充分治理投入时，本州环境严格程度的提高会导致企业规模缩小。（JEL L11, L51, R38）

title: Environmental Compliance Costs and the Distribution of Emissions in the US
abstract: Using the properties of the Gini coefficient, a structural model is developed to assess the impact of uniform changes in environmental compliance costs on the distribution of per capita emissions across U.S. counties and states, a distribution that places a larger burden on minorities. Using data from the U.S. EPA’s Toxic Release Inventory and three state‐specific measures of environmental compliance costs, we find that uniform increases in federal environmental standards have little impact on the distribution of environmental hazards, and may actually exacerbate spatial inequality. As a result, Federal standards that target specific high pollution locations are necessary to redress current inequities.
abstract_zh: 利用基尼系数的性质，本文构建了一个结构模型，以评估环境合规成本的统一变动对美国各县和各州人均排放分布的影响，而这一分布会给少数族裔带来更大的负担。利用美国环保署有毒物质释放清单（TRI）数据以及三项针对各州的环境合规成本度量，我们发现联邦环境标准的统一提高对环境危害的分布影响甚微，甚至可能加剧空间不平等。因此，针对特定高污染地区的联邦标准对于纠正现有的不公平现象是必要的。

title: Environmental Regulation and Productivity Growth: An Analysis of U.S. Manufacturing Industries
venue: Empirical Modeling of the Economy and the Environment
abstract: We show that traditional measures of productivity change that ignore the unproductive nature of pollution abatement capital within the production process are likely to underestimate the true productivity gains that most manufacturing industries are able to generate in any given year. While the average bias of traditional measures is not large in absolute terms,the bias can be substantial for industries with relatively large pollution abatement capital expenditures. We also find that environmental regulation has a non-trivial adverse effect on productivity change,lowering productivity growth by roughly 0.3% across all industries,and by more than 1% for some industries.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，若传统的生产率变化度量忽略了污染治理资本在生产过程中的非生产性，则可能低估大多数制造行业在任一年份所实现的真实生产率提升。尽管传统度量的平均偏差在绝对值上并不大，但对于污染治理资本支出相对较大的行业，偏差可能相当显著。我们还发现，环境监管对生产率变化具有不可忽视的负面影响，使所有行业的生产率增长大约降低0.3%，而对部分行业则降低超过1%。

title: Estimating Worklife Expectancies: An Econometric Approach
Industrial and Environmental Specialization
abstract: The presence of threshold effects or convex damage functions implies that the composition of pollutants may be as important in the determination of health outcomes as the level of pollution. As such, greater specialization in particular environmental hazards may suggest increasing costs from pollution even if overall pollution levels are declining. Using panel data from the US, it is verified that ‘environmental specialization’ is important, and likely to increase in the future due to greater industrial specialization.
abstract_zh: 阈值效应或凸性损害函数的存在意味着，污染物的构成与污染水平本身一样，都可能对健康结果产生重要影响。因此，在特定环境危害上的专业化程度提高，可能意味着即便总体污染水平下降，污染成本仍在上升。利用美国的面板数据，本文验证了“环境专业化”的重要性，并且随着产业专业化程度的提高，这一现象在未来可能会更为突出。

title: The Environmental Kuznets Curve: Real Progress or Misspecified Models?
abstract: We explore the importance of modeling strategies when estimating the emissions-income relationship. Using U.S. state-level panel data on nitrogen oxide and sulfur dioxide emissions, we estimate several environmental Kuznets curves using the standard parametric framework as well as a more flexible semiparametric alternative. Formal statistical comparisons of the results overwhelmingly reject the parametric approach. Moreover, the differences, particularly for sulfur dioxide, are economically significant.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了在估计排放与收入关系时，建模策略的重要性。利用美国各州氮氧化物和二氧化硫排放的州级面板数据，我们既采用标准的参数化框架，又采用更为灵活的半参数替代方法，估计了若干环境库兹涅茨曲线。对结果进行的正式统计比较，绝大多数情况下都拒绝了参数化方法。此外，这些差异（尤其是对于二氧化硫而言）在经济上具有显著意义。

title: Measuring the Effects of Environmental Regulations on Manufacturing Plant Births: A New Empirical Paradigm
venue: Environmental Economics and the International Economy
abstract: The effect of environmental regulations on capital flows has been examined empirically for nearly three decades. We revisit this literature using a unique county-level data set for New York State from 1980–1990, and a new empirical model: a semi-nonparametric empirical method based on propensity score matching. Our empirical estimates suggest that “dirty” firms are responding to environmental regulations, but more importantly we find that traditional parametric methods used in previous studies may dramatically understate the impact of more stringent environmental regulations.
